# Required Pi 4 FAT boot files for the K35 image. Fields: path, minimum bytes, check.
# The `pi4-serial.sh --check` manifest check reads this file with `mtype`; the checks are
# `config` (the K35 config.txt contract lines), `kernel` (non-zero AArch64 image),
# `fdt` (big-endian 0xd00dfeed magic) and `none`.
config.txt 1 config
kernel8.img 65536 kernel
bcm2711-rpi-4-b.dtb 1024 fdt
bootcode.bin 4096 none
start4.elf 1048576 none
fixup4.dat 1024 none
LICENCE.broadcom 1 none
overlays/disable-bt.dtbo 512 fdt
